kakutei-shinkoku v1.0.1

- Added a new README.md file for improved documentation and onboarding.
- Updated SKILL.md with minor clarifications (no major content changes).

Initial release — assistant for Japan freelancer tax filing (確定申告):

- Helps freelancers and side-job workers organize income, expenses, and deductions for annual tax returns in Japan
- Provides detailed categories for income and deductible expenses, including home office calculations
- Explains relevant deductions, credits, tax brackets, and consumption tax (invoice system)
- Covers tax calendar, filing methods (e-Tax, paper, in-person), and blue vs white return details
- No API connections, no My Number handling — knowledge-based support only
- Includes clear legal disclaimers and usage instructions for self-preparation and accountant consultation
